title: yoshida card review (format 1)
description: Written by the editor. The command line does not read it. An approval stays valid while the card and the design inputs hash to the same value.

cards.description: Reviews by card file path, then by card id. A card without an entry is unreviewed.

hash.description: Hash of the card's values (and its id when the design reads card.id) and the design inputs (the design file and the components it includes) when it was reviewed. A different hash turns an approval into 'changed since review'.
